BiblicalUsage: Tubal-cain is the son of Lamech and Zillah, the first worker in brass and iron. In Genesis 4:22, she also bare Tubal-cain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tubal-cain matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
